PIRACY.gloss: hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts
PIRACY.definition: Hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts; taking a ship or plane away from the control of those who are legally entitled to it.

PAIR.gloss: a set of two similar things considered as a unit
PAIR.definition: A set of two similar things considered as a unit.

PRAY.gloss: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship
PRAY.definition: Address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer.

AIRY.gloss: open to or abounding in fresh air
AIRY.definition: Open to or abounding in fresh air.

PAY.gloss: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services
PAY.definition: Give money, usually in exchange for goods or services.
PAY.example: I paid four dollars for this sandwich.

CAR.gloss: a motor vehicle with four wheels
CAR.definition: A motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.
CAR.example: He needs a car to get to work.

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

RAY.definition: A column of light (as from a beacon).

CRY.definition: A loud utterance; often in protest or opposition.
CRY.example: The speaker was interrupted by loud cries from the rear of the audience.

RIP.example: The curtain ripped from top to bottom.

ARC.gloss: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
ARC.definition: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field.

PIC.gloss: a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving…
PIC.definition: A form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement.
PIC.example: They went to a movie every Saturday night.

PAR.gloss: the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire…
PAR.definition: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course.

RAP.gloss: a reproach for some lapse or misdeed
RAP.definition: A reproach for some lapse or misdeed.
RAP.example: He took the blame for it.
